entries.name: Kimberly Jeannine Trimiew

expected.charges: Civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony
expected.sentence: About two weeks in custody in October 1993; released on bail October 20. The contempt order was subsequently affirmed November 12, 1993.

updates.sentence: Civil contempt detention October 5-20, 1993, followed by release on bail pending appeal. The contempt order was subsequently affirmed November 12, 1993. This is separate from the February-August 1994 detention.

entries.rationale: Samhain 1993 journal printed page 8 explicitly gives October 5 admission. Preserve independently reported October 20 bail release; 15 elapsed days.

entries.name: Kimberly Jeannine Trimiew

expected.charges: Civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony after immunity
expected.sentence: Confined beginning February 18, 1994, and still jailed in June reporting. The Ninth Circuit affirmed the contempt order March 28. Exact release date unverified.

updates.sentence: Civil contempt confinement February 18-August 29, 1994. Trimiew personally reported her August 29 release in Earth First!, Mabon 1994, printed page 6. She described 193 days inclusive; the site uses 192 elapsed days. The intervening period on bail after October 1993 is excluded.

entries.rationale: Signed first-person release account visually verified on original page. Completes second interval. Together the two distinct intervals total 207 elapsed days.

entries.name: Mark Davis

expected.charges: Federal attempted destruction of an electrical transmission line used in interstate commerce — Earth First! / EMETIC nighttime sabotage of transmission towers in northern Arizona, 1986-89
expected.sentence:
6 years federal prison + $19,821 restitution

Verdict as recorded: Yes — guilty plea, U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona, 1991

updates.sentence:
6 years federal prison + $19,821 restitution

Verdict as recorded: Yes — guilty plea, U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona, 1991 Custody dates corrected from contemporary Earth First! reporting and official BOP register 23106-008. Admission 1991-09-23; end of BOP custody 1995-06-20. This federal-custody endpoint includes the community-corrections phase and is not represented as a prison-to-halfway-house transfer date. Earlier arrest/bail time is not counted as continuous confinement.

entries.rationale: Original contemporary journal identifies actual sentence admission and register number; ordinary BOP lookup matches that register and records actual release. Correct legacy admission and release rather than deriving served time from nominal sentence. Halfway-house placement remains within BOP custody.
